title: Your 2027 Calendar for Personalized Products: When Each Season Really Peaks
summary: The holidays are only a third of the year. See when each 2027 season peaks for personalized products, and when to launch.
body_markdown:
Ask most personalized-product sellers when they make their money and they'll say November and December. They're right that it's the biggest stretch of the year. But it's only a third of it.


We looked at almost three years of orders from stores that run[Customily](https://www.customily.com/) on six platforms, including Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce and Amazon, from **January 2024 to October 2026** . In 2024, November and December made up 34% of the year's sales. In 2025, 33%. The other two-thirds came from the rest of the calendar, and some of those months are bigger than most sellers plan for.


Here's when each season really peaks, which products sell when, and what to do month by month in 2027.


## Why personalized products are a must for 2027


Generic print-on-demand is a race to the bottom: the same design on the same mug can be listed by a thousand stores, and the cheapest one wins. A product made for one person can't be compared that way. Shoppers pay for their dog's face, their kids' names or the date they got married, not for the mug.


**The dates that sell the most are the ones built around people.** In our data, the biggest stretches of the year are Mother's Day, the weeks before Valentine's Day and the holidays. On those days a generic gift feels like an afterthought. Shoppers want something with a name, a face or a date on it, something made for one person. In 2027, that won't be a nice extra; it's what shoppers will expect from a gift on the days that matter most.


Personalization also earns more per order. A[personalized product](https://www.customily.com/our-features) sells on what it means, not on the price of the blank, so it can carry a higher price than the same item without personalization and competes less on price. And once a shopper has personalized one product, it's easy to offer the same name or photo on a second one: about 1 in 7 orders already includes two or more items. If you want more sales and more income per order in 2027, personalization is the most direct way to get both.


The category keeps growing too. Industry estimates put the global **personalized gifts market** at about $34 billion in 2026, **heading toward $36 billion in 2027.** And our data shows personalized gifts selling steadily beyond the big holidays: the quiet months now count for more than they did two years ago.


What shoppers expect has changed with it. They want to see exactly what they're buying before they pay, they expect it to arrive on time, and more and more of them want their photo turned into something new, like a cartoon, an anime portrait or an oil painting. Stores that can deliver that, on every channel where their buyers shop, are the ones that will grow in 2027.

##### Valentine's Day: Sunday, February 14


On the monthly chart, January and February look quiet: both stayed below a typical month in all three years. That hides how concentrated Valentine's demand is. In 2026, the busiest day of the first quarter was Sunday, February 1, and Valentine's Day itself was 42% quieter than that peak.


In 2027, Valentine's Day falls on the same Sunday as the Super Bowl, which makes a good hook for couples' and football-themed designs. Have Valentine's products live by mid-January and spend most of your budget in the last week of January. For product ideas, see our[Valentine's Day inspiration](https://www.customily.com/post/valentines-day-inspiration) . For the week-by-week plan, see[Don't Switch Off in January: What Q1 Really Looks Like.](https://www.customily.com/post/dont-switch-off-in-january-valentines-sales-start-early)


##### Mother's Day: Sunday, May 9


This is the biggest season outside the holidays. May was the second-biggest month in 2024, 2025 and 2026, and April and May together brought in about 1 in 5 of the year's sales (20% in 2024, 19% in 2025). April is already above a typical month every year, and Mother's Day shoppers start arriving five to six weeks early.


Have Mother's Day products live by Monday, March 29. For what to sell, see our[Mother's Day gift ideas to sell in your store](https://www.customily.com/post/mothers-day-gift-ideas-to-sell-in-your-store) and the[Mother's Day trends shaping sales](https://www.customily.com/post/mother-s-day-trends) .


##### Father's Day: Sunday, June 20


Father's Day is a smaller season. June landed between 90% and 104% of a typical month, then July was the quietest month of every summer. Launch Father's Day products in early May, while Mother's Day traffic is still high, so the same shoppers see them.


Need ideas? Check our[personalized Father's Day gifts for every type of dad](https://www.customily.com/post/the-most-creative-product-ideas-for-fathers-day-gifts) and these[tips to boost Father's Day sales](https://www.customily.com/post/boost-your-father-s-day-sales-our-top-tips-for-online-stores) .


##### Summer: July to September


July to September is the quietest stretch after early spring: about 16% of the year's sales across three months. It's the time to build next season's designs, refresh product photos and test new products, not to switch off ads entirely. A good place to start: our list of[personalized products to sell this fall](https://www.customily.com/post/best-personalized-print-on-demand-products-to-sell-this-fall) and our[Q4 strategies to sell more](https://www.customily.com/post/the-q4-strategies-to-sell-more-and-boost-your-business) .


##### The October climb


Holiday shopping starts in October, not November. October was between 123% and 151% of a typical month in all three years. Have holiday products live by the end of September so they are ready when the climb begins. Halloween, on Sunday, October 31, is part of the climb too: see our[personalized Halloween product ideas](https://www.customily.com/post/creative-ideas-and-trends-for-personalized-halloween-products) and[Halloween marketing ideas](https://www.customily.com/post/marketing-and-sales-tips-for-the-halloween-season) .


##### The holidays: Thanksgiving November 25, Christmas on a Saturday


November is the biggest month of the year, bigger than December: 2.8 times a typical month in 2024 and 2.6 times in 2025, against 2.4 times for December both years.


In 2027, Black Friday is November 26 and Cyber Monday is November 29. Personalized gifts take time to make and ship, and more than half of each year's November-December orders came in November. Set a clear order-by date for Christmas delivery and show it on every product page.


To plan the season, see our[Christmas marketing ideas](https://www.customily.com/post/preparation-for-the-christmas-season-strategies-for-selling-personalized-products) , the[print-on-demand products to sell this Christmas](https://www.customily.com/post/top-print-on-demand-products-you-must-sell-this-christmas) and our[Black Friday ideas for personalized products](https://www.customily.com/post/personalization-ideas-for-black-friday-get-ready-for-the-big-sales-day) .

The products that sell all year are built from the same three pieces. In October 2026, 94% of sales came from products using the image uploader, 90% from products with dynamic images, and 83% from products with personalized text. Newer touches are catching on fast: text shadows went from zero to almost 5% of sales in a year.


These are the[Customily tools](https://www.customily.com/our-features) to have in place before your first 2027 season:


- **Live preview.** Shoppers see their exact product, with their photo, names and options, before they add it to the cart. Nobody has to imagine the result, which is what gets a personalized gift bought.
- **Image uploader.** Shoppers add their own photo straight into the design and see it in the live preview. It's the most used tool in our data, in 94% of October 2026 sales.
- **Dynamic images.** The artwork in the design can change with the shopper's options: they pick a pet breed, a hairstyle or how many people to include, and the design updates on the spot. One template covers hundreds of combinations.
- **Photo and AI effects.** Remove the background, cut out a face, or turn a photo into an anime portrait, an oil painting, a Renaissance painting or a cartoon. AI styles went from almost no sales a year ago to a visible share of them in late 2026.
- **One-click tools for seasonal products.** Crosswords, calendars, maps, song plaques, star maps and moon phases, ready to drop into a design.
- **Automatic print files.** Every order creates its own production-ready print file and sends it to your fulfillment. In November, when orders run at more than twice a typical month, nobody on your team has to touch a design.
- **Cross-selling.** Offer the same personalization on a second product, like the photo from a mug on an ornament too. About 1 in 7 orders already has two or more items, so the demand is there.
- **One account for every platform.** Sell on Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, WooCommerce and more from the same Customily account, using the same templates. Build a design once and sell it wherever your buyers are.

Some personalized products follow their own calendar. Three show a clear peak in our data.


- **Maps peak around Valentine's Day.** February was the biggest month for map products in 2024, 2025 and 2026. A map marks a place that matters to a couple, which makes it a natural Valentine's gift. Launch map designs with your Valentine's range in January.
- **Crosswords peak in December.** December was the biggest month for crossword gifts in both years they were on sale. In December 2025 they reached 2.4% of all personalized sales, more than double their level in the rest of the year. Add a crossword design to your holiday range by October.
- **Song plaques jumped before Valentine's 2026.** Products with a Spotify-style song code had their biggest month ever in January 2026, almost five times their December level. It's one year of data, so treat it as a strong signal, not a pattern yet. If you sell to couples, a song plaque belongs in your Valentine's range.


One more to watch: **word clouds** had a single spike in April 2026, ahead of Mother's Day. A product made of a mom's favorite words or her kids' names fits the season, but one spike isn't enough to plan around.


### The quiet months are getting less quiet


The peaks are getting softer. In 2024, May was 74% above a typical month. In 2025 it was 53% above, and in 2026, 29% above. Meanwhile the quiet months moved up: January to March went from 67% of a typical month in 2024 to 83% in 2026, and June to September from 87% to 95%.


The shape of the year hasn't changed. The holidays are still the biggest stretch, and Mother's Day is still second. But each quiet month now counts for more than it did two years ago. Switching off ads and launches between seasons costs more sales than it used to.


What's behind it isn't in this data. It could be shoppers buying personalized gifts for more everyday occasions, like birthdays and anniversaries, or a change in the kinds of stores selling them. Either way, the advice is the same: **plan for the whole year, not just the peaks.**

## Plan the whole year, not just the holidays


The holidays will always be your biggest stretch, but they're only a third of the year. The other two-thirds come in waves you can see coming: Valentine's in late January, Mother's Day from late March, the climb from October. **Every season rewards the sellers who launch early, and the quiet months matter more than they used to.**

### Frequently Asked Questions


**When do personalized product sales peak?**


November is the biggest month of the year, followed by December. In 2024 and 2025, November was 2.6 to 2.8 times a typical month, and December was 2.4 times.


**What is the biggest season for personalized gifts after Christmas?**


Mother's Day. May was the second-biggest month in 2024, 2025 and 2026, and April and May together brought in about 1 in 5 of the year's sales.


**What share of personalized product sales come from the holidays?**


About a third. November and December made up 34% of the year's sales in 2024 and 33% in 2025.


**When should I launch Mother's Day products in 2027?**


By Monday, March 29. Mother's Day is Sunday, May 9, and shoppers start arriving five to six weeks early.


**When should I launch holiday products?**


By the end of September. Holiday sales start climbing in October, which was between 123% and 151% of a typical month in all three years.


**Which personalized products sell best for Valentine's Day?**


In our data, maps have their biggest month in February every year, and song plaques had their biggest month ever in January 2026.
